How Halloween (1978) connects

  • Artist: John Carpenter — Carpenter directed and scored Halloween (1978).
  • Topic: Halloween — Halloween (1978) is the film that starts the franchise.
  • Character: Michael Myers — Halloween (1978) is the night Michael comes home.
  • Character: Laurie Strode — The 1978 film is Laurie's first fight with the Shape.
  • Artist: Debra Hill — Debra Hill co-wrote and produced Halloween (1978).
  • Character: Dr. Sam Loomis — Loomis hunts Michael through the 1978 film.
  • Location: Haddonfield — The 1978 film is set on Halloween night in Haddonfield.
  • Work: Halloween II — Halloween II picks up the same night as the 1978 film.
  • Work: Halloween II — Halloween II is preceded by the 1978 original.
  • Event: The Night He Came Home — The tagline names the night of the 1978 film.

What is Halloween (1978)?

Halloween (1978) follows Michael Myers's escape from Smith's Grove and his Halloween-night hunt through Haddonfield, opposed by Laurie Strode and Dr. Loomis.

Key threads lead to John Carpenter, Halloween, Michael Myers, Laurie Strode, Debra Hill and Dr. Sam Loomis.
